shortlist.label: Colorectal adenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: High-grade, poorly differentiated neoplasm with invasion through muscularis propria to serosal surface and lymph node metastasis

shortlist.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Large fungating sigmoid mass with near-complete luminal obstruction and negative immunohistochemistry for keratin and other markers

shortlist.label: Sigmoid colon cancer
shortlist.why_kept: 10.1 cm × 12.2 cm × 11.0 cm heterogeneous proximal sigmoid mass on CT abdomen and surgical pathology findings

shortlist.label: Lymphoma of the colon
shortlist.why_kept: Abdominal mass with weight loss and altered bowel habits, although less likely given the surgical pathology findings

shortlist.label: Leiomyosarcoma of the colon
shortlist.why_kept: High-grade, poorly differentiated neoplasm with invasion through muscularis propria to serosal surface and negative immunohistochemistry for desmin and other muscle markers

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms, such as abdominal distension, abdominal pain, diarrhea, weight loss, and decreased stool caliber, along with the presence of a palpable mass in the left lower quadrant, are consistent with a diagnosis of sigmoid colon cancer. The CT abdomen and flexible sigmoidoscopy findings of a large heterogeneous proximal sigmoid mass with near-complete luminal obstruction further support this diagnosis. The surgical pathology showing a high-grade, poorly differentiated neoplasm with invasion through muscularis propria to serosal surface and lymph node metastasis also aligns with sigmoid colon cancer.

rejected.label: Colorectal adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: While this is a possible diagnosis, sigmoid colon cancer is more specific and directly related to the location of the mass found in the patient.

rejected.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
rejected.why: The pathology findings do not support this diagnosis, as the tumor is described as a high-grade, poorly differentiated neoplasm, which is not typical of gastrointestinal stromal tumors.

rejected.label: Lymphoma of the colon
rejected.why: The pathology findings do not support this diagnosis, as the tumor is described as a high-grade, poorly differentiated neoplasm with invasion through muscularis propria to serosal surface, which is not typical of lymphoma.

rejected.label: Leiomyosarcoma of the colon
rejected.why: The pathology findings do not support this diagnosis, as the tumor is described as a high-grade, poorly differentiated neoplasm, and immunohistochemistry results are negative for desmin and other markers typically positive in leiomyosarcoma.
